A01-session-expired and A01-identity-recheck-failed are separate pending states after splitting the former combined session record.
A prompt or queue row without a PNG stays pending. Alias rows are links, not additional pending drawings or completed images.
Static review proves visible image content only, not interaction, service, or production behavior.
